query: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM idempotency WHERE conversation_id = $1 AND execution_status = 'queued') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM channel_wakes w JOIN idempotency i ON i.conversation_id = w.conversation_id AND i.key = w.key WHERE w.conversation_id = $1 AND NOT w.started AND i.execution_status <> 'failed' AND w.sent_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - interval '15 minutes') AS "queued!"
